newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Red-chip Shum Yip seen in HK$455-525 mln IPO.
newsitem.headline: Red-chip Shum Yip seen in HK$455-525 mln IPO.

text.p: Shum Yip Holdings Co Ltd is expected to raise HK$455 million to HK$525 million in an initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong later in February, market sources said on Monday.
Sources said the Hong Kong-based red-chip company is expected to price its shares at a prospective price to earnings multiple of 10.9 times and a 12 percent discount to its net asset value per share.
Red chips are Hong Kong-based firms which have strong backing from a Chinese parent.

Shum Yip -- backed by the municipal government of the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen -- engages in infrastructure development, including toll roads, transportation and property development, sources said.
Peregrine is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, they said.
No further details were immediately available, they added.
